The 6 format tests pass, but I'm not calling Task 3 done yet. Two things are open:

- **TDD order:** I edited `tides/format.py` before I had seen the new test fail. The skill treats that as code-before-test, so I'd redo it.
- **Unrelated-looking failure:** `make check` fails on `tests/test_sync.py::test_offline_cache_refill`, and I don't yet know whether my change caused it.

I haven't seen the file contents in this turn, so I can't write exact edit lines. The steps in order:

**1. Revert the production change.** The diff against `main` touches only `tides/format.py` and `tests/test_format.py`, so this loses nothing else.

<command>git checkout main -- tides/format.py</command>

**2. Watch the test fail (RED).** This also gives a free baseline for the sync failure, since `format.py` is now `main`'s version.

<command>uv run pytest -q --golden tests/test_format.py tests/test_sync.py::test_offline_cache_refill</command>

I expect the new format test to fail on an assertion about the unrounded height, not on an import error or typo. If the sync test also fails here, it is pre-existing and unrelated to my change.

**3. Re-implement (GREEN).** I'd write the minimal rounding to 0.01 m in `tides/format.py` from the test alone, without copying the old edit.

**4. Verify.**

<command>uv run pytest -q --golden tests/test_format.py</command>
<command>make check</command>
<command>ruff check .</command>

I run `ruff` separately because `make check` may have stopped at the pytest failure, so lint is unverified so far.

**5. If the sync test fails only with my change,** I'd check whether `tides/sync` uses the formatter and fix that at the cause. I won't edit the sync test or loosen its assertion.

**Message to my partner:**

> Task 3 status: rounding to 0.01 m is implemented in `tides/format.py`, and `tests/test_format.py` (6 tests) passes.
>
> Two caveats:
> 1. I wrote the code before watching the new test fail, which breaks the TDD rule. I'm reverting `format.py`, confirming the test fails for the right reason, and re-implementing it.
> 2. `make check` (with `--golden`) shows 1 failure: `tests/test_sync.py::test_offline_cache_refill` (`assert 41 == 48`). My diff doesn't touch sync code, so I suspect it's pre-existing, but I haven't confirmed that. The baseline run in step 2 will settle it. If it fails without my change too, I'll leave it alone and report it. I won't change that test without your say-so.
>
> Also unverified: `ruff check .` (it may not have run after the pytest failure). One test in `tests/test_stations.py` is skipped because it needs `TIDE_LIVE=1`. I haven't run it, and it looks unrelated to formatting.
>
> I'll report back with the actual outputs once the steps above are done.
